source_title: Daytime Emmy Awards Winners List (Updating Live)
source_excerpt:
General Hospital won for Outstanding Drama while Beyond the Gates triumphed in the actress categories at the 53rd annual Daytime Emmy Awards on Friday.
The marquee win for GH was it’s sixth in a row in the category, besting fellow daytime drama nominees Peacock’s Days of Our Lives and the CBS duo of The Young and the Restless and newcomer Beyond the Gates .
RELATED: Daytime Emmy Awards 2026 Photos: Best Of The Red Carpet
Beyond the Gates had a strong showing in its first year of eligibility, tying GH with four wins overall, notably scoring two big acting prizes: Tamara Tunie for Outstanding Actress and Ambyr Michelle for Emerging Talent.
The Kelly Clarkson Show meanwhile prevailed yet again after it wrapped for good in August, scoring five wins including Outstanding Talk Series. It was part of a trend for shows making their final appearances here: Sherri Shepherd won for hosting her now-canceled eponymous talk show.
Clarkson led the night with five wins, with The Young and the Restless (the leading nominee coming into the show) winning three and a few shows scoring double wins: Be My Guest with Ina Garten, the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, Long Way Home and A Different Breed .
Other notable individual winners tonight included Keke Palmer for her digital miniseries Glam Through the Ages , and Star Jones won her first Emmy for hosting Divorce Court.
RELATED: 2026-27 Awards Season Calendar: Oscars, Emmys, Grammys, Guilds & More
General Hospital star Genie Francis was recognized with a Life Achievement Award for playing Laura Spencer on the longtime ABC sudser. “I know 50 years sounds like an awfully long time, but it doesn’t feel like that to me,” she said. “As they say, if you love what you do, you never work a day in your life.”
The three-hour, orchestra-free ceremony at the Hollywood Palladium was streamed live via YouTube and featured Cheap A$$ Beach Houses ’ Matthew Hoffman in an offstage role as the “Voice of God.” The show also featured mini-tributes to soaps over the years, which included an appearance by Juliet Mills who remembered Passions .
See the program and distributor scorecards and the full list of winners below.
